sun.computed_in: web/src/cosmos/sun.ts, in the reader's browser, for the instant shown
sun.formula: subsolar point from the Astronomical Almanac's low-precision solar coordinates: n = JD - 2451545.0; L = 280.460 + 0.9856474n; g = 357.528 + 0.9856003n; lambda = L + 1.915 sin g + 0.020 sin 2g; epsilon = 23.439 - 0.0000004n; latitude = asin(sin epsilon sin lambda); longitude = atan2(cos epsilon sin lambda, cos lambda) - GMST (IAU 1982)
